findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "company_signals" stacks urgency/override words (never, attention). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_intel_bulk, company_people, company_search, person_search, person_signals, add_opt_out · Private data: analyze_contact, analyze_contacts, email_intel, email_intel_bulk, company_signals, company_people, person_search, person_signals, add_opt_out, remove_opt_out · Public sink: analyze_contacts, email_intel, email_intel_bulk, build_icp_profile, company_people, person_search, person_signals, add_opt_out · Destructive: email_intel, email_intel_bulk, person_search, remove_opt_out.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_intel_bulk, company_people, company_search, person_search, person_signals, add_opt_out · Private data: analyze_contact, analyze_contacts, email_intel, email_intel_bulk, company_signals, company_people, person_search, person_signals, add_opt_out, remove_opt_out · Public sink: analyze_contacts, email_intel, email_intel_bulk, build_icp_profile, company_people, person_search, person_signals, add_opt_out · Destructive: email_intel, email_intel_bulk, person_search, remove_opt_out

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
